bounds_note: The outer edges of every image are exactly these bounds (pixel corners, not centres). Images were resampled bilinearly from the 15 m UTM grid (EPSG:32640).

stretch.quantity: Landsat B8 top-of-atmosphere reflectance / sin(sun elevation)
stretch.rule: one stretch per instrument, the same for every year of that instrument: percentiles [0.5, 99.5] of all in-box pixels of its scenes. ETM+ pan (0.52-0.90 um) includes near-infrared where sand is brighter than in OLI/OLI-2 pan (0.50-0.68 um), so ETM+ vs OLI brightness differences are partly instrumental. Projected frames use the stretch of the latest scene's instrument.

observed_format: JPEG, grayscale, opaque (no-data would be black; see nodata_pixels)
masking: Landsat QA_PIXEL fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud and cloud shadow (dilated by one 15 m pixel) are no-data
projection_method: Semi-Lagrangian advection of the latest observed image along the measured 2013-2025 dune-motion field: output(x) = image(x - u(x) * years), cubic interpolation. u = velocity of windows with detected motion only (0 below the detection limit, in masked/non-dune areas and outside dune windows), 3x3-window median filter, Gaussian smoothing (sigma = 120 m), bilinear to 15 m, times a feathered free-sand mask. median case = measured velocity; fast case = same heading at speed + 1 sigma (84th percentile of the speed). Assumes the 2013-2025 motion continues unchanged; dunes do not deform, merge, grow or get removed.
projection_reading_note: These frames change very little: by 2050 the median case moves 32.9 % of the box, by a median 27.03 m (1.8 px) and at most 66.77 m; the fast case at most 72.19 m. The other 67.1 % of the box is drawn unchanged, because motion there is below the detection limit or the ground is not dune sand. The small change is the measurement, not a rendering problem.

use_values.measurement: Landsat 8/9 frame of the velocity network (2013-2025)
use_values.long_baseline_check: Landsat 7 frame before the scan-line-corrector failure, used only in the long-baseline check of the velocities
use_values.display_only: Landsat 7 frame shown on the timeline only, 2002-2012 (after 31 May 2003 with scan-line gaps; off_month = not November); not used for any measurement

display_only_format: WebP, grey (R = G = B) lossy + lossless alpha (alpha 0 = no data: scan-line gaps and QA-masked cloud/shadow); same grid, bounds and ETM+ stretch as the observed frames
display_only_masking: scan-line gaps (B8 = 0 or QA_PIXEL fill) exactly as delivered; QA_PIXEL dilated cloud, cloud and cloud shadow dilated by one 15 m pixel, as for the observed frames; a frame pixel is no-data if any source pixel under it is. Nothing is interpolated or filled.
display_only_note: These frames show the place in the years before 2013 without a measured frame. They are images only: not in the velocity network, the Landsat 7 long-baseline check (2000 and 2001 only), the registration, any statistic, the threat years or the projection. Landsat 7's scan line corrector failed on 31 May 2003; its later images have stripes with no data (has_scan_line_gaps). Where no November scene was usable, an October or December scene (September as a last resort) is shown instead (off_month), with its sun elevation against the November range (sun_note).
display_only_alignment_note: Display-only frames are drawn as delivered, like every other frame (none is resampled to remove registration offsets; the measurement removes them numerically). Their offset from the first Landsat 8 image, measured on stable reference ground against each of the 14 confirmed images (481 stable-ground windows of 480 m (notebook 02's stable-ground rule without its coherence filter)), is E -7.3 to +5.9 m and N -1.6 to +2.4 m (largest 7.3 m, 0.49 pixel); the confirmed frames' own offsets span E -1.4 to +3.9 m and N -0.6 to +1.5 m. None lies more than half a pixel (7.5 m) outside that range, so none was shifted. Collection 2 model fit to ground control (GEOMETRIC_RMSE_MODEL) for these scenes: 4.6-5.6 m.
